paragraphs: This demo highlights the Zen Cart platform with the newly updated Responsive Classic Template. The template has been refreshed to provide a modern, optimized shopping experience that works seamlessly across a variety of devices and screen sizes.
• Fully Responsive Design: Automatically adjusts to fit any screen size, ensuring a smooth shopping experience on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
• User-Friendly Interface: Clean, intuitive, and easy-to-navigate layout designed to enhance user experience and accessibility.
features: Clone or Download the Project: Clone or download the demo files from this repository to your local machine.
Upload Files to Your Server: Extract the downloaded files and upload the 'images' and 'includes' folder to your web server.
Optional: You can also download the 'updateddemoimage.zip' for additional image assets.
Optional: Add the CSS file when using the One Page Checkout plugin to match site styling.
Optional: Fully featured image gallery with thumbnails, drag/swipe scrolling, infinite looping, arrows, and a modal lightbox

requirements.text: Activate the Template: Log in to Zen Cart and navigate to Tools > Template Section.
